title: Functional Test Report
subtitle: Plant Information Dashboard
meta: Branch sit. Before fixes: ed63d97. After fixes: 8aad28b (fixes) and 6d35510 (QA suites)
Isolated local QA copy: API 127.0.0.1:3010, frontend localhost:5176, throwaway PostgreSQL 16 seeded with Bekasi data and a second test site
Claude Code (prod-readiness-checks), for the PID project team
Pass. API 132/132, UI 27/28 after fixes. 13 of 14 defects fixed; 1 Low open (F-11).

blocks.p: Every backend route group and every main page was tested with **positive** (the feature works) and **negative** (bad input, missing rights, another site, switched-off module, unknown ids, duplicates) scenarios. Defects found were fixed, then the suites were run again on the fixed code.

No Critical or High defects were found. **14 defects** (3 Medium, 11 Low) came from 20 failing scenarios; **13 are fixed** and verified. The one open item, F-11, is Low: the two stock pages agree on totals but classify an empty tank differently, which shifts that tank's capacity between commodity rows.

blocks.note: Go/no-go (functional): **Go.** F-11 does not block production; schedule it for the next release.

bullets: **Environment:** a local copy started from the repository: its own PostgreSQL container (migrated, seeded with the Bekasi logsheet, lab and stock data), the API and the frontend dev server. No shared server was written to.

**API scenarios:** `qa/functional/api-suite.mjs`, 132 scenarios, re-runnable and idempotent. It creates its own fixtures (company qa-ft-co, sites qa-ft-site and qa-ft-site2, qa-ft- users and roles) and writes `results.json`.
**UI scenarios:** 28 scenarios run in a browser against the frontend: sign-in, every main page, dialogs, validation, restricted users, navigation, console errors.
**Accounts:** the dev-only seed admin, plus a restricted user, a master-data editor and a delegated user-admin created by the suite.
**Out of scope:** real gauges and DataHub (only unreachable test addresses), load testing, browsers other than Chromium.

blocks.p: Positive/negative split of the API scenarios: 60 positive, 72 negative.
"PASS (fixed)" failed before the fixes and passes now. "(new)" was added with the fixes: FT-TG-15 checks that loopback and cloud-metadata gauge addresses are refused.

blocks.p: Test-design corrections (not product defects): five scenarios were corrected during the first run (wrong parameters or fixture clashes). After the fixes, the gauge fixture moved from 127.0.0.1 to an unresolvable `.invalid` host, because loopback addresses are now refused on purpose, and FT-OPS-06 accepts `invalid_date` as the code for a malformed day.

blocks.p: `Backend/.env.qa` holds random test-only secrets and is gitignored. The suite signs in many times from one address, so it runs with the per-address limits raised; the limits themselves are tested by the penetration test (PT-RL-01).
